description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) INetflixSecurity within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares virtual methods related to Netflix security features, such as retrieving ESN and keys, and deriving keys using Diffie-Hellman. It acts as a contract for implementations that handle Netflix security in the system.

classes.name: INetflixSecurity
classes.description: An interface class providing methods for interacting with Netflix security features, including key retrieval and derivation.

methods.name: ESN
methods.description: Returns the ESN (Electronic Serial Number) as a string.

methods.name: EncryptionKey
methods.description: Returns the pre-shared encryption key as a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: HMACKey
methods.description: Returns the pre-shared HMAC key as a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: WrappingKey
methods.description: Returns the pre-shared wrapping key as a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: DeriveKeys
methods.description: Derives encryption, HMAC, and wrapping keys based on a Diffie-Hellman key exchange, given private and peer public key IDs, and outputs the derived key IDs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of INetflixSecurity.
